- **Osprey site:** Dock 37. Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct.
- **Osprey deadline:** 26 August. Dana posted this in #north-random on 14 Oct but didn't give a year. 26 Aug 2026 had already passed, so I asked her then whether she meant 2027. I haven't found her answer, so I told Marcus to check with Dana before putting a year in the handover.
- **Door 6 duplicate arrivals:** Thea Ramaswell, Quarrendon Freight Lines' Director of Yard Operations and main contact. She reported the problem: the same trailer showed up twice on the morning shift, once from the driver's kiosk check-in and again when dispatch added him by hand. Dana was handling it on our side (#north-team, 20 Aug 2025).

The reply has no money terms and nothing from anyone's DMs, so no approval was needed.
